added: Every submission is now recorded, not just the accepted ones — filter Solved by what took you several tries, or what you have not revisited
Write notes on any problem; they go into that problem's page in your repo
Pick a username when you connect GitHub, unique across LeetSync
README index collapses into per-difficulty sections once it outgrows a flat table, so a large repo stays readable

Usage reporting is asked once during setup instead of hiding in Settings, and still starts off
Sharing your solution code is a separate switch that stays off even when reporting is on
An activity ping, on by default and with its own switch: a random ID and the version, twice a day at most, so a dormant install is not mistaken for one that declined reporting — nothing else is sent

Send feedback, an issue or a suggestion from Settings — and get an answer back inside the extension, quoting what you wrote
